_comment: wave 25 (gap-closing batch): four scalar constructors/arithmetic + two two-temporal makes, all via existing build_generic machinery. minus_date_date (date_base + scalar -> int) and minus_timestamptz_timestamptz (timestamptz_base + scalar -> Interval) close the date/time scalar-arithmetic gap; box3d_make / gbox_make (base scalar primary + scalar extras -> PostGIS box text) close the PostGIS box constructors using the box3d_text_out / gbox_text_out return-kinds added in waves 17/18; tcbuffer_make / tpose_make (two hex-WKB temporal operands -> hex-WKB temporal, the add_tnumber_tnumber cross-stream shape) close the temporal constructors. All six probed green against the v15 libmeos before generation (tools/codegen/wave25_probe.c).

operators.comment_one_liner: minus_date_date (int) - the number of days between two dates.
minus_timestamptz_timestamptz (Interval *) - the interval between two timestamps.
box3d_make (BOX3D *) - a PostGIS BOX3D from its bounds (xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax,zmin,zmax,srid).
gbox_make (GBOX *) - a PostGIS GBOX from hasz and its bounds (xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax,zmin,zmax).
tcbuffer_make (Temporal *) - a temporal circular buffer from a temporal point and a temporal float radius.
tpose_make (Temporal *) - a temporal pose from a temporal point and a temporal float orientation.
